name: Riverwheel Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold that teaches its own variation of Riverwalk magic.

description_citations.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, the young Kuhnde is tested by the masters of the strongholds and found competent in all disciplines, though expert in none, so they recognize him as suited to be a mantis rider.
timeline.quote: He was competent in all the disciplines, although not an expert, but they all recognized in Kuhnde the skill set that was required of being a mantis rider.

citation.text: "Way of the Mantis" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2014.
